thread_text:
Riley: Quick PSA: brought my cat to the office for an afternoon run — she staged a one-cat opera on my keyboard. Photo + tiny clip inbound 3a4
Nina: wait OPERA CAT?? must see now :scream_cat:
Riley: uploaded: <https://imgur.com/a/opera_cat|opera_cat_solo.jpg>  she literally sat on the F and J keys and meowed in descending scales for like 10 seconds 
OpsBot: Friendly reminder: please keep pets on designated desks and avoid prolonged contact with shared equipment. See https://intranet/pets for rules.
Max: this is performance art. did she hit any enterprise shortcuts? ctrl-alt-del? :joy:
Riley: she triggered a rogue hotkey that opened a spreadsheet of last quarter's pizza orders. apologies to finance :grimacing:
Sophie: votes for bringing sheet music next time. can we get subtitles for the meows? maybe partner with the soundtrack team
Lyla: caption contest: "When the sprint demo goes off script" 3b5 :raised_hands:
Nina: also: is she allowed on other desks if everyone agrees? would volunteer my desk for a cameo. she seems to prefer warm laptop zones
OpsBot: If other employees consent and the pet is registered for a visit, temporary desk visits are permitted. Upload vaccination docs if not already done.
Riley: registered her this morning under "Cadenza" and uploaded vax. also brought a clean towel to put over keyboards while she naps 
Max: dropped by with a tiny toy microphone. Cadenza performed an encore: muffled purring + keyboard percussion. tiny clip: <https://youtu.be/cadenza-encore>
Sophie: we should make a sticker: "Cadenza was here" for the snack fridge. high risk, high charm
Lyla: officially nominating Cadenza for Employee of the Hour. who do i tag for ceremonial plushie? :trophy:
Riley: thanks all! leaving sign up: "Cadenza on break 2:30-3:00" 338. will post another nap pic later
Nina: reacts with :heart_eyes: and :clap: — can't wait for nap pics
OpsBot: Note: if pet visits become weekly, please submit a recurring pet schedule form.
